A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DRL is an effective method to solve dynamic pricing problems on E-commerce platform.
, in E-commerce platform, a dynamic pricing model with DRCR as reward function, continuous action space and cold-start problem solved by historical data is the best model.
, in E-commerce, the DRL-based dynamic price model is able to generate a better pricing policy, which is more stable and more profitable, compared to the traditional price optimization methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the DRL-based dynamic price model can be applied to real-world E-commerce platforms, with continuous pricing actions, unknown demand function and cold-start problem.
, the DRCR reward function is better than the revenue-only reward function on e-commerce platform, and continuous action model performs significantly better than the discrete action model.
, for dynamic pricing on E-commerce platforms, the reward function is the most important part of the model, and it is necessary to design different reward functions for different business scenarios.
